Participating hotels list Our selection RISAN, Montenegro Mövenpick Hotel & Residences Teuta Kotor Bay Nestled in the heart of Montenegro's Bay of Kotor, Mövenpick Hotel & Residences Teuta Kotor Bay is a refined waterfront retreat where contemporary luxury, wellness and authentic Adriatic charm meet between Kotor and Perast. Surrounded by dramatic mountains and crystal-clear sea views, it offers an elevated escape for families and solo travellers, with elegant rooms, destination dining, private sandy beach, spa experiences, and access to iconic cultural and natural attractions. MYKONOS, Greece Kove Hotel & Spa Mykonos - MGallery Collection Kove Hotel and Spa Mykonos is a refined boutique retreat set on the narrow isthmus between Ornos and Korfos for a rare sense of shelter and island energy close at hand. Minimalist design meets authentic Mykonian character, with thoughtfully designed rooms and suites, an olive-lined pool, and eNa restaurant for elevated Greek gastronomy. Restore in the Cave Spa with hammam rooms, jacuzzi and immersive therapies, minutes from Mykonos Town. KNUTSFORD, United Kingdom Fairmont Cheshire The Mere Step into Fairmont Cheshire, The Mere, a reimagined countryside retreat where the timeless charm of the original hotel meets refined modern luxury. Set beside the tranquil waters of The Mere Lake, guests can unwind in elegant accommodations, enjoy exceptional dining including Gordon Ramsay at The Mere, and experience world-class spa and golf facilities, all delivered with thoughtful service and the warmth of Cheshire hospitality. BARCELONA, Spain ibis budget Barcelona Center Located between the sea and the city in the heart of the Poblenou district, this hotel is ideal for discovering Barcelona. Just a 10-minute walk from the beach, it offers direct access to iconic landmarks like La Rambla, the Gothic Quarter, La Sagrada Familia, Passeig de Gracia, Placa de Catalunya, Ciutadella Park and Port Olimpic. Enjoy the best of the city with nearby urban beaches and leisure options. BRUSSELS, Belgium ibis Styles Brussels Centre Rogier Ibis Styles Brussels Centre Rogier welcomes you in the heart of Brussels, between North Station and the Botanical Garden. Inspired by travel, nature and poetry, the hotel offers a bright, soothing retreat within the city his rhythm. Its design blends urban energy, greenery and modern comfort, for a stay that is both practical and inspiring, just steps from the capitals main attractions. LOURDES, France greet hotel Lourdes Centre Pyrénées Your GREET hotel, located near the Sanctuary, offers a magnificent view of the Pyrenees. Its contemporary style and fun ambience make it ideal for tourist or business stays. It offers 63 silent rooms. It also has a panoramic restaurant, a bar, a lounge and free public parking nearby. The warm welcome and prime location guarantee a peaceful and friendly stay throughout the seasons. MAZAN, France Château de Mazan - Handwritten Collection Welcome to Provence and Chateau de Mazan. At the foot of Mont Ventoux, this authentic and elegant residence, once the summer residence of the Marquis de Sade and the birthplace of the first theater festival in 1772, enjoys a rich history. Its gardens inspired by the Grand Masters invite conviviality and sharing. Its 31 rooms and suites offer charm, with each space offering a timeless art of living. NOVI VINODOLSKI, Croatia Mövenpick Hotel and Residences Kvarner Bay Weekend packages for October/November are live. For the autumn holidays, 22 to 28 October and 2 to 8 November, you can book them any night of the week. Enter your dates, add 2 adults or your family, and choose from the Deals and packages tab. 4 to pick from, each with half board, check in until midnight, a six o'clock checkout. Or take the plain half board rate and keep it simple. A new beachfront resort above the Adriatic. Outdoor pools, a pebble beach and all day dining. Salterra Spa opens winter 2026. VASTRA FROLUNDA, Sweden Mercure Gothenburg Mercure Hotel Gothenburg sits by the sea in the historic Nya Varvet shipyard district, 15 minutes from central Gothenburg. Set in buildings dating back to the 1800s, it blends maritime heritage with modern Scandinavian design. The 97 rooms range from Standard to Suite, many with harbour views. Relax at the bar and enjoy food and drinks outdoors in the sun, with sweeping views over the water. A 24-hour deli and lobby shop, meeting facilities and free parking with charging stations complete the stay. CHESTER, United Kingdom The Queen at Chester Hotel - Handwritten Collection Since 1860 we have been creating wonderful experiences for discerning travelers, situated at the gateway to Chester we provide a welcome and stylish escape, a place to rest from your journey, and a luxurious and well-connected base to make the most of Chester and beyond. The hotel is famous for its rich heritage, stunning public areas serving great food, afternoon teas and signature cocktails, with its hidden gem - the terrace, a tranquil oasis in the heart of the city. CHIPPENHAM, United Kingdom Lucknam Park, Emblems Collection A gracious Palladian mansion set within 500 acres of exquisite parkland in Wiltshire. It sits at the southern edge of the Cotswolds, a region celebrated for its romantic landscapes, ancient woodlands, and storybook villages. Just a short drive from Regency Bath, the estate feels both tucked away and perfectly placed. NANTERRE, France Aparthotel Adagio Access Paris Nanterre La Défense The Adagio Access Nanterre La Défense enjoys a prime location with quick access to La Défense and central Paris. In the heart of Nanterre, near the historic center, Sainte-Geneviève Cathedral and the Arboretum. Experience concerts and events at Paris La Défense Arena, just 5 minutes away via RER. Featuring 132 studios with A/C, equipped kitchens, WIFI, TV, parking, seminar room and buffet breakfast.
